company.description: Rubber Ducky Labs is a technology company focused on AI-powered product discovery for e-commerce. Its platform enables teams to enhance product metadata, allowing non-technical users to upload catalogs and generate rich metadata using multi-modal AI. The tool supports applications in search, recommendations, marketing, and SEO, helping retailers deliver personalized experiences and optimize product visibility.
